Trip to the Championship'') is the first chapter of the [[Pokémon Gold & Silver: The Golden Boys]] manga. ==Plot== {{spoilers}} The chapter begins with {{GnB|Gold}}, a new Trainer from [[New Bark Town]] beginning his Pokémon journey. Gold is in a battle against {{tc|Youngster}} [[Joey]]. Gold sends out his {{TP|Gold|Totodile}}, and Joey sends out his {{p|Rattata}}. Rattata is commanded to use {{m|Hyper Fang}} against {{p|Totodile}}, while Totodile is told to dodge it with a {{m|Bite}} attack. Gold easily defeats Youngster Joey. In a flashback earlier, Gold was in [[Professor Elm]]'s Lab where he asked Gold to run an errand for him. Professor Elm had needed Gold to visit [[Mr. Pokémon]], near [[Cherrygrove City]] to inquire about an important discovery. Gold was asked to pick a [[first partner Pokémon]] to help him along. Gold was presented with {{p|Chikorita}}, but he considered it too cute for his tastes. Next up was a {{p|Cyndaquil}}, and as Gold was about to pick it, a Totodile had surprised him by biting his arm. The Totodile seemed to have had a liking to Gold and so he ended up choosing Totodile as his [[List of characters' first Pokémon|first Pokémon]] instead. Professor Elm gave Gold a [[Pokégear]], when Gold had noticed a shadow near the window. Professor Elm told him it's nothing and to not worry about such trivial things. The defeated Youngster Joey offers Gold tips and advice and records his Pokégear number. Gold is about to head off, when he notices an injured {{TP|Gold|Pidgey}} in the grass. Joey and Gold run up to it to try to help, but realize they can’t reach a Pokémon Center. Nearby they find a {{i|Berry}} tree, and later Gold feeds a Berry to the bruised {{p|Pidgey}}. Gold is about to head off again, when he receives a panicked call from Professor Elm, asking him to return to the lab immediately. Gold is almost attacked by a {{m|Razor Leaf}} as {{GnB|Black}} appears. Black says that he was the one who stole the {{TP|Black|Chikorita}} from Elm’s lab, because he thought it was strong. He also admits that the injured Pidgey had belonged to him earlier, but he had released it because it was weak. Gold is angry to hear this and challenges him to a battle. Gold sends out his Totodile against Black's Chikorita, and is at an obvious type disadvantage. Black commands Chikorita to use Razor Leaf which ends up hitting Totodile. Chikorita is commanded to use Razor Leaf again and this time Gold blocks its attack while protecting Totodile. The Pidgey from earlier however, steps in front to protect Gold. Gold commands it to use {{m|Gust}} attack on Chikorita, who is then defeated. Black brushes off the defeat and tells Gold he that he is going for the championships, as Gold looks on. ==Major events== * {{OBP|Gold|Golden Boys}} begins his journey with his {{TP|Gold|Totodile}}. * Gold catches a {{TP|Gold|Pidgey}}. * Gold encounters {{OBP|Black|Golden Boys}} and defeats him. ===Debuts=== ====Pokémon debuts==== * {{p|Hoothoot}} * {{p|Rattata}} * {{p|Jigglypuff}} * {{p|Dugtrio}} * {{p|Voltorb}} * {{p|Ledyba}} * {{p|Spinarak}} * {{p|Totodile}} ({{OP|Gold|Totodile}}) * {{p|Cyndaquil}} * {{p|Pidgey}} ({{OP|Gold|Pidgey}}) * {{p|Chikorita}} ({{OP|Black|Chikorita}}) ==Characters== ===Humans=== * {{OBP|Gold|Golden Boys}} * {{OBP|Black|Golden Boys}} * {{tc|Youngster}} [[Joey]] * {{tc|Firebreather}} (intro) * {{tc|School Kid|Schoolboy}} (intro) ===Pokémon=== * {{p|Totodile}} ({{OP|Gold|Totodile}}) * {{p|Chikorita}} ({{OP|Black|Chikorita}}) * {{p|Pidgey}} ({{OP|Gold|Pidgey}}; new) * {{p|Rattata}} ([[Joey]]'s) * {{p|Hoothoot}} * {{p|Cyndaquil}} * {{p|Jigglypuff}} (intro) * {{p|Dugtrio}} (intro) * {{p|Voltorb}} (intro) * {{p|Ledyba}} (intro) * {{p|Spinarak}} (intro) {{-}} {{MangaPrevNext |prevcode=None |prevtitle= |nextcode=GB02 |nexttitle=Falkner, The Bird Keeper's Challenge!! |series=Pokémon Gold & Silver: The Golden Boys |colorscheme=Johto}} {{Project Manga notice}} [[es:GB01]] [[it:GB01]] [[zh:宝可梦金・银版 黄金少年 第1话]]
